components.name: button
components.summary: Triggers an action in place: submit a form, open a dialog, save.
avoid: Navigating to another page: use a link
Decoration or labels with no action

practices.do: Use one primary button per view. Make the rest secondary.
Write the label as a verb that says what happens: 'Send message', not 'OK'.
Set type="submit" explicitly for form submission. The default is type="button".

practices.dont: Restyle it with raw colors. Extend the variants with color tokens.

props.name: variant
props.description: `primary` for the main action of a view, `secondary` for everything else.

examples.name: primary
secondary

components.name: input
components.summary: Single-line text field with a visible label, optional hint and error.
use: Short free text: name, email, search
avoid: Choosing from a fixed list: use a select or radios

practices.do: Pass a visible label. The component requires it.

practices.dont: Use the placeholder as the label or to hold instructions. Use hint.

practices.do: Set type and autoComplete so browsers and password managers can help.
Write errors that say how to fix the value, not just that it is wrong.

practices.dont: Color the field with raw values to show errors. Pass error.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Marks the field invalid and replaces the hint.
props.note: Sets aria-invalid and links the message with aria-describedby.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Required: placeholders are not labels.

with-error
